water_window_method: Native median9 RGB R>215 G>235 B>195 G-R>=8; only inside named-source-water windows plus conservative native named-water interior polygons, applied after majority, not global pale exclusion
water_evidence: Actual native named pale-green striped water: Markakol and Bukhtarma reservoir/Lake Zaysan. Spatially bounded source-water review windows use observed green-vs-yellow native ink separation. No global white/blue water exclusion. Native pale mapped peninsulas inside review windows are explicitly checked and retained. Strict interior polygons, traced wholly within named Markakol/Lake Zaysan water in native scan crops, exclude large brown bathymetric letters/contours that color matching otherwise falsely treats as geological islands. They are not invented geological polygons or interpreted modern shoreline boundaries; pale mapped shore peninsulas remain outside the interior masks.

method: Actual legend-swatch Lab segmentation, not SAM. Text/hatch filtering and majority smoothing; no removed-small-region holes or nearest-neighbor geological infill. Corrected Kazakhstan border including Baikonur is unchanged.
